notes.title: Patch 0.69
notes.content:
Smaller patch this time still with 2 new cards and a rework. We added a 1 cost dark elf, due to Aldori’s rework as well as added a 1 cost Orc to round up Hero being pools some more. A few small balance fixes and bugfixes for the new cards from the last patch.

[h1]New cards:[/h1]

[h2]Beings:[/h2]

[list]
[*] Citadel Spy - 1 cost - Rare - Dark Elf - 0/1
[list]
[*] When played, draw a card if your opponent controls a being. If your opponent controls both an Aura and a being, draw two cards instead.
[/list]
[/list]

[list]
[*] Bulwark Guardian - 1 cost - Common - Orc - 1/1 - Guard
[list]
[*] When your opponent plays a being, Bulwark Guardian gains a +0/+1 buff.
[/list]
[/list]

[h2]Rework:
[/h2]

[list]
[*] Aldori, The Last Wardancer - 6 cost - Epic - Dark Elf - 5/5 - Speed
[list]
[*] After attacking and surviving, another being may gain a +2/+2 buff and Spellward.
[/list]
[/list]

[h2]Balance:[/h2]

[list]
[*] Baldor, Second Lieutenant
[list]
[*] Now spawns a 1/1 angel
[/list]
[/list]

[list]
[*] Shaman of the East 
[list]
[*] Now 3 cost - 1/3 - Still spawns a 2/4 when it dies. - Is now Orc/Mage
[/list]
[/list]

[h2]UI:[/h2]

[list]
[*] Added deck images for all new cards from this and last patch.
[/list]

[h2]Bugs:[/h2]

[list]
[*] Fixed a bug where it was possible to claim more rewards than intended
[*] Several bug fixes with the new cards released last patch.
[*] Small fix on Infernal Wolf interactions.
[*] Fixes for Zyn consecutive activations.
[*] Small fixes for Cassius
[*] Apocalypse fix
[/list]

notes.title: Patch 0.66
notes.content:
[h2]Mechanics:[/h2]

[list]
[*] In patch 0.64 we changed which afterlife cards go to depending on the owner of the card. After some testing we came to the conclusion that it's unintuitive as well as causing bugs with Resurrect abilities. We decided to take the WYSIWYG approach and have the cards go to the afterlife of whoever last controlled the card.

As an example, if the player plays opponents Magician of Nin from the Sharedboard, it will now go to the players afterlife when it dies. Likewise if an opponent stole players' Tamed Frost Elemental with The Puppet Master or Evil Matar's hero power, it will go to the opponents afterlife if it dies while controlled by the opponent.

The change in the last patch introduced some new bugs with ownership eg. Tinas and other resurrect abilities, that should now all be fixed.
[*] Silence has been slightly reworked to provide more clarity:
Using Silence on a being works the same as before. It will remove any buffs/debuffs, text and all abilities from the targeted being. This is how Shackles or Orb of Silence's 1st option work.
"Can't be silenced" effect on cards such as The Alchemist or Ultimate Defense was very ambiguous as it was very unclear about its meaning. Especially since none of the abilities in the game directly silence the Hero. We reworded it to "Immune to negative effects". This means you are not affected by cards that prevent you from playing cards such as The Heretic or No More. You are also immune to Tax effects.
[/list]

[h2]UI and VFX:[/h2]

[list]
[*] We have added a new buff history window when you hover over cards on board. You can now see all buffs/debuffs affecting the card and their sources.
[*] When clicking to attack, valid targets will now show with a green outline. (This feature is Work in progress and will still sometimes show some highlights wrong)
[*] Several fixes for the Match history, it will now display more events and should be more useful to see past actions.
[*] Foil cards should have the "foil" effect more pronounced in hand and on the board.
[*] All transcendent cards now have the "transcendent fire" VFX.
[/list]

[h2]Auras:[/h2]
[list]
[*] Protection Auras now display the selected option when you hover over them. This tooltip will only show to the opponent once aura has been triggered.
[/list]

[h2]Beings:[/h2]
[list]
[*] Elas: Reworded all 3 versions from "Can't be destroyed by global spells and abilities" to "Immune to global spells and abilities".
[*] Elnaril: Reworded to "Immune to Freeze".
[*] The Alchemist: Reworded "Can't be silenced" to "Immune to negative effects".
[/list]

[h2]Spells:[/h2]
[list]
[*] Shackles: Adjusted reminder text to indicate that silence removes all buffs/debuffs as well as any abilities and text.
[*] Ultimate Defense: Reworded "Can't be silenced" to "Immune to negative effects".
[/list]

[h2]Bug Fixes:[/h2]
[list]
[*] Fixed Hidden VFX obscuring too much of the cards on board.
[*] Fixed energy portrait indicator not showing remaining energy if no augment is selected.
[*] Fixed Sharedboard or Heroic Being cards getting stuck to your cursor.
[*] Fixed Tinas not allowing you to resurrect beings or auras in your afterlife.
[*] Fixed One of Seven's Transfusion ability refreshing on every turn.
[*] Energy counter is now displayed even when no augment is selected.
[*] Fix for Guard arrows sometimes pointing at the wrong card.
[*] Fix for targeted spells not being properly destroyed when played from the Sharedboard.
[*] Reforge stones should now be disabled when there are none in the inventory.
[*] Fixed some sounds triggering more than intended.
[*] Trapping roots should no longer trigger on beings getting to low health instead of the hero.
[*] Some text updates for clarity.
[*] VFX will now be loaded on match start rather than first use, alleviating some potential FPS spikes when abilities and cards are played for the first time.
[*] The Original being should now work correctly.
[/list]

notes.title: Patch 0.65.0
notes.content:
[h1]New Feature :[/h1]

New Feature :

Reforge Stones:

Legendary Reforge stone

Transcendent Reforge stone


We have enabled the inventory tab in your collections. You can now receive reforge stones from the Standard packs, that can be bought in our store. Once you open them in a pack, they will appear in your inventory.

In the Variations tab, there will now be a new option to reforge your Legendary or Transcendent cards. With the Legendary Reforge stone, you can change one Transcendent ability either on your Legendary or your Transcendent card. With the Transcendent reforge stone, you can change both abilities on your Transcendent cards only.

The drop rates in the Standard packs will be as follows:

Legendary Reforge stone - 1.5% / pack 
Transcendent Reforge stone - 0.5% / pack 


[h1]User Interface:[/h1]
[list]
[*] New Frames for Hero cards
[*] New Frames for Energy cards
[*] Slight change in the default card back.
[*] Deckbuilder and card collections are now more compact and more readable.
[*] Energy Filters are not darker when not selected.
[*] Titles now have a new frame
[*] Rewards tab will now select correctly when clicked.
[*] Card descriptions will now react better to the mouse wheel and not scroll to the top anymore.
[*] Card details will now appear more smoothly when hovered in hand and on the board.
[*] Clicking on the ground received some tweaking
[*] Mark of Death now has a new image.
[*] Hero cards are now the same size as other cards in the collection and the deckbuilder.
[*] Added background blur to all menus to make them more readable.
[*] Several other smaller tweaks to the UI
[/list]

[h1]Beings:[/h1]
[list]
[*] Ruthless Demon - Changed rarity from Common to Epic. Moved from Starter set to Prologue. No longer part of the Starter decks.
[*] Shieldmaiden - Changed rarity from Common to Epic. Moved from Starter set to Prologue. No longer part of the Starter decks.
[/list]

[h1]Bug Fixes:[/h1]
[list]
[*] Fixed Barrier of Protection’s first option incorrectly triggering on friendly spells.
[*] Fixed some sounds still being played even with volume sliders at minimum.
[*] Fixed issue with Arcane not drawing the correct amount of cards if near or at maximum hand size.
[*] Fixed deck card count not working correctly.
[*] Several options menu fixes.
[*] Fixed text fields on login screen.
[*] Fixed Aura Burn’s 2nd option being grayed out even if the player had 3 energy available.
[*] Fixed Siege Commander Cassius and Shield Wall buffs not clearing from beings if they were stolen by Matar or The Puppet Master.
[*] Fixed Desert Energy not triggering if a player casts a spell with increased/decreased energy cost such as one put in hand by Elder Orb of Urna.
[*] Afterlife fix for removed card not being updated visually.
[*] Toggling the menu animated background button will now correctly enable the apply button.
[/list]

notes.title: Patch 0.64.0
notes.content:
[h1]UI:[/h1]
[list]
[*] We have improved card text readability. It is not perfect on some cards due to the constraints of the Unreal Engine, but it should be better for most cards and in line with the - - images on our website. This is a work-in-progress, so we will be happy with any feedback you can provide.
[*] Added color coded words for abilities. Passive abilities are colored blue, active abilities are colored green.
[*] We have added an energy counter on the hero frame, so now you have a better view of the energy at a glance.
[*] There is now a setting to disable the moving background in the menu to improve performance.
[*] The cards in hand are now slightly lower and slightly smaller to make some room for the secondary hero power icon and the tooltip. Being moved to the bottom of the hero frame.
[*] added a "x" next to the search and filters to clear the bar quickly.
[/list]

[h1]Mechanics:[/h1]
[list]
[*] When cards are destroyed or entering the afterlife generally. They will now always go to their owners afterlife.
[*] Cards will now always correctly go to the bottom of the deck when a mechanic puts them back in the deck.
[/list]

[h1]Auras:[/h1]
[list]
[*] Barrier of Protection - Slightly reworded the second option.
[/list]

[h1]Beings:[/h1]
[list]
[*] Apep, Demon of the South - Slightly reworded the ability.
[*] Black Forest Guard - Slightly reworded the ability.
[*] Mad Elf - Changed wording to reflect two separate abilities tied to either burrowing or unburrowing.
[*] Mistake, King of the Underworld - Slightly reworded the ability.
[*] Restless Elven Spirit - Added Spirit subtype. It’s now a proper Elf Spirit.
[*] River Golem - Changed wording to reflect two separate abilities tied to either burrowing or unburrowing.
[*] Subterranean Terror - Slightly reworded the ability.
[*] The Black One - Slightly reworded the ability.
[*] The White One - Slightly reworded the ability.
[/list]

[h1]Spells:[/h1]
[list]

notes.title: Patch 0.62.0
notes.content:
[h3]Notes: Due to player feedback, we are working on a new starting player experience. We have decided to completely rework the early levels and . There will be a developer insight post on this topic going into more detail. But it seems the current early player experience is quite overwhelming for new players. Replay feature is also nearing completion.
[/h3]

[h1]Experimental:[/h1]
[list]
[*] We have removed the experimental feature where your opponent’s decklist was visible due to player feedback.
[/list]

[h1]UI:[/h1]
[list]
[*] We have added a new pack opening sequence. Let us know what you think about it! There are still some optimizations we have to do on the scene, so you might experience some performance issues.

[/list]

[*] One of Seven will correctly enter as 1/1 (7/7 with six -1/-1 debuffs) when resurrected by Cazit’gul’s Hero Power or when copied by Thor, God Among Men.

[*] Playing another card very quickly after casting Book of Secrets, Dark Ranger or Trained Falcon will no longer leave the card permanently attached to the cursor. (again)
[*] Deck card count should now be correct for both players.
[*] East Orc Marauder will now correctly gain Speed when mind controlled by the puppet master if the player controls 3 or more beings.
[*] Improvements to cards moving to the Sharedboard.
[*] Fix for card preview position not being updated correctly.
[*] Protection auras should work better.
[*] Some small Delay fixes
[/list]

notes.title: Patch 0.54 - 07.12.2023 - current
notes.content:
Heroes:

- You can now disenchant or craft multiple cards.
- Wins in the matchmaking now grant 100 crystals, they have to last longer than 2 minutes.

- River Golem should again appropriately tax.

- Fixed Siege Commander Cassius interaction with adjacent beings.
- The Original Being now correctly returns beings to their owners hands rather than controllers.
- Starting hand should no longer error out when time is running out. Some other QOL fixes with ban phase.
- Beryn should now correctly change illustration when shapeshifting.
- Transformed beings now appear on the same place on the board
- Card packs should now correctly show all items in addition to all cards
- Several matchmaking fixes

- Adjusted, Moonlight, Frost and Dark Energy augment colors to be more distinctive.

tags.bug: - The Shadow should now work correctly.
- River Golem should again appropriately tax.
- Abilities that trigger on unburrowing work correctly when Alun or Clear Skies effects happen.
- The White One and The Black One no longer disappear on transformation when the board is full.
- Illsar’s Hero Power can no longer be used on burrowed beings.
- Fixed Siege Commander Cassius interaction with adjacent beings.
- The Original Being now correctly returns beings to their owners hands rather than controllers.
- Starting hand should no longer error out when time is running out. Some other QOL fixes with ban phase.
- Beryn should now correctly change illustration when shapeshifting.
- Transformed beings now appear on the same place on the board
- Card packs should now correctly show all items in addition to all cards
- Several matchmaking fixes
